Video Creator AI 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Create, edit, and export videos from images or video clips (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG up to 500MB)
- Cloud-based GPU rendering with automatic session setup and authentication
- 1080p MP4 exports; supports text, music, overlays, and smooth transitions from 5–10 images
- Handles tokens, sessions, uploads, and exports; simple SSE-driven editing workflows
- Robust error handling and user feedback throughout creation and export process
